# Optimized Performance & Wellness

> Mobile IV therapy based in Jupiter, Florida. A licensed registered nurse, overseen by a medical director, brings IV hydration and vitamin drips to homes, offices, hotels and rentals across northern Palm Beach County and the Treasure Coast. Every visit starts with a health screening and takes 45 to 60 minutes. Drips cost $150 to $435. Book by text.

- Phone / text: +1 (561) 503-0046 or +1 (561) 312-6570
- Email: optiperfwell@gmail.com
- Ages treated: 10 and older; whole households in one visit
- Every drip includes 1 liter of Lactated Ringer's or normal saline
- NAD+ add-on: $50 for any drip
- Not emergency care: for trouble breathing, chest pain, confusion, a fever that won't come down, or severe dehydration in a child, call a doctor or 911.

## IV menu
- [Foundational Meyers ($245)](https://optimizediv.com/iv-menu/foundational-meyers/): Our signature drip. Immune support and hydration for when you're coming down with something.
- [Travel Defense ($250)](https://optimizediv.com/iv-menu/travel-defense/): Before or after a trip, or when everyone around you is coughing. Stay one step ahead.
- [Recover ($235)](https://optimizediv.com/iv-menu/recover/): After an illness, a tough week or a hard workout. Rehydrate and replenish so your body can recover.
- [Glow ($300)](https://optimizediv.com/iv-menu/glow/): Named for the brighter, more radiant-looking skin it supports. A favorite before weddings, photo shoots, galas and any day you want to look and feel your best.
- [Optimized Meyers ($350)](https://optimizediv.com/iv-menu/optimized-meyers/): A deeper reset with extra support for energy and recovery on top of the essentials.
- [Your Call ($150)](https://optimizediv.com/iv-menu/your-call/): IV fluids plus any 3 add-ins you choose from the list below, and many other options are available. Not sure? Your nurse will help you pick.
- [Get Right ($435)](https://optimizediv.com/iv-menu/get-right/): Our everything bag for the worst days. Fluids, vitamins and antioxidants to get you back on your feet.
